verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript 3D library, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability for its ecosystem and the axis applies. The runtime probe explicitly records that no three.js MCP server exists, official or notable community, and that agents drive the library directly through npm. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are adjacent machine-readable docs, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
